conclusion_scope: The native ordinary component owns one chain of body and numbered pin records. KiCad unit-0 physical pins can therefore be emitted once in an additional common view in this same component, with explicit shared-view placement loss. This transforms original common records, never deduplicates positive-unit repeated records. Common graphics remain in logical views; the additional view contains only original common pins and their decorative markers. Independent unit placement, native hierarchy, ERC and implicit global-net behavior are not claimed.
